Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live''

SPECIFICATION  FOR 

GAUGING  MEMBERS  FOR  PLAIN  PLUG  GAUGES 

GO  AND  NO  GO  MEMBERS 

(SIZE  RANGE  ABOVE  40  TO  120  mm) 

(  First  Revision  )

1.  Scope  — Covers  requirements  for  gauging  members  for  plain  plug  gauges  for  GO  and  NO 
GO-  members  in  the  size  range  above  40  up  to  and  including  120  mm.  These  plain  plug  gauges 
can  also  be  used  to  check  the  minor  diameter  of  internal  threads  when  made  accordmg  to 
IS  :  4218  -  1976  (  Parts  I  —  VI  )  '  ISO  metric  screw  threads  '. 

2.  Material  —  Shall  be  as  prescribed  in  IS  :  7018  (  Part  I )- 1973  '  Technical  supply  conditions  for 
gauges '. 

3.  Dimensions  — Dimensions  and  tolerances  for  the  GO  and  NO  60  gauging  members  for 
plain  plug  gauges  shall  be  as  specified  in  Table  1  read  with  Fig.  1  to  3. 


TABLE  1     GO  AND  NO  GO  GAUGING  MEMBERS  FOR  PLAIN  PLUG  GAUGES

IS  :  6244  -  1980 

4.  Gauging  Dimensions  — Gauging  dimensions  for  plain  plug  guages  shall  conform  to 
IS  :  3455  -  1971  *  Gauging  practice  for  plain  workpieces  (first  revision  Y  and  IS  :  2334  -  1975 
•Gauging  practice  for  ISO  metric  screw  threads  (first  revision)  'for  checking  plain  work-pieces 
and  minor  diameter  of  internal  threads  respectively. 

5.  Air  Grooves  —  For  gaugmg  of  bimd  holes  a  suitable  air  groove  may  be  provided  on  a  GO 
gauging  member. 

6.  Designation 

6.1  Gauging  members  for  plain  plug  gauges  shall  be  designated  by  nominal  diameter  of  the  hole 
and  the  tolerance  class  according  to  IS  :  919  (Part  I )  -  1963  *  Recommendations  for  limits  and  fits 
for  engineering:  Part  I  General  engineering  (first  revision )  \ 

Examp/e : 

A  GO  or  NO  GO  gauging  member  for  plain  plug  gauge  to  check  a  hole  or  nominal  size 
50  mm  and  tolerance  class  H8  according  to  IS  :  919  (Part  I )  -  1963  shall  be  designated  as: 

GO  Gauging  r/iember  50-H8  IS  :  6244 
NO  GO  Gauging  Member  50-H8  IS  :  6244 

8.2  If  tolerances  other  than  according  to  IS  :  919  (  Part  I )  -  1963  are  required,  gauging  members  for 
plain  plug  gauges  shall  be  designated  by  the  nominal  size  of  the  hole  and  the  limits. 

Example: 

A  GO  or  NO  GO  gauging  member  for  piam  plug  gauge  to  check  a  hole  of  nominal  size 
55  mm  and  with  a  tolerance  of  +o*2  shall  be  designated  as. 

0 

GO  Gauging  Membei  55  t  o  2  |S  :  6244 

0 

NO  GO  Gauging  Member  55   -^^'^  ,S  .  6244 

6.3  Gauging  members  for  checking  minor  diameter  of  internal  ISO  metric  screw  threads  shall  be 
designated  by  nominal  size  of  the  thread  and  tolerance  class  according  to  IS  :  4218  (  Part  IV  )  - 1976 
•  ISO  metric  screw  threads:  Part  IV  Tolerancing  system  '. 

Example: 

A  GO  or  NO  GO  gauging  member  for  plain  plug  gauge  to  check  the  minor  diameter  of 
internal  ISO  metric  screw  thread  size  M45  and  tolerance  class  6H  on  the  minor  diameter 
according  to  IS  :  4218  -  1976  shall  be  designated  as: 

GO  Gauging  Member  M45-6H  IS  :  6244 
NO  GO  Gauging  Member  M45-6H  IS  :  6244 

6.4  Gauging  members  for  checking  a  blind  hole  shall  be  designated  with  a  prefix  BH  before  the 
size: 

Example : 

A  GO  or  NO  GO  gauging  member  for  plain  plug  gauge  to  check  a  blind  hole  (  BH  )  50 
and  tolerance  class  H8  shall  be  designated  as: 

GO  Gauging  Member  BH  50-Hd  IS  :  6244 
NO  GO  Gauging  Member  BH  50-H8  IS  :  6244 

7.  General  Requirements  — Other  requirements  for  gauging  members  for  plain  plug  gauges  not 
covered  In  this  standard  shall  conform  to  IS  :  7018  (  Part  I )  -  1973  •  Technical  supply  conditions  for 
gauges:  Part  I  General  *. 

8.  Marking  -  Shall  be  in  conformity  with  IS  :  7018  (  Part  I )  - 1973. 

8.1   Certification  Marking  —  Details  available   with   the   Bureau  of  \nd\an  Standards.

IS  :  6244  -  1980 

EXPL A  N ATOR Y     NOTE 

This  Standard  was  originally  published  in  1971.    At  the  time  of  reviewing  the  specification, 
the  committee   responsible  for   its   preparation  felt  if  necessary  to  rationalize  it  on  the  basis 
of  ISO  3670- 1979  '  Blanlis  for  plug  gauges  and  handles  (taperlock  and  trilock)  and  ring  gauges 
design  and  general  dimensions  ',  issued  by  the  Imernational  Organization  for  Standardization. 

The  main  deviations  are: 

i)  Gauging  members  for  plain  plug  gauges  GO  and  NO  GO  members  (size  range 
above  40  up  to  120  mm )  have  been  combined  to  cover  the  requirements  of  GO  and 
NO  GO  gauging  members  in  one  specification.  IS  :  6245-1971  '  Gauging  members  for 
plain  plug  gauges  NO  GO  member  ( size  range  30  to  100  mm  )  *  stands  withdrawn, 

ii)  Diameter  range  has  been  changed  to  40-120  mm  from  the  earlier  30-100  mm; 

iii)  The  discrepancies  in  the  co-ordination  of  gauging  members  and   handles   have   been 
diminated; 

iv)  Chamfer  details  on  measuring  face  have  been  added; 

v)  Alternate  design  given  in  earlier  version  has  been  deleted;  and 

vi)  Surface  fmish  symbols  have  been  changed  to  N  values. 

The  design  in  the  range  specified  in  this  specification  is  with  trilock  fitting  of  gauging 
member  to  the  handle.    This  extends  the  interchangeable  end  system  to  the  larger  size. 

An  additional  advantage  of  this  type  of  gauge  is  that  the  gauging  members  can  be  reversed 
when  the  entering  end  is  worn.  The  wedge  shaped  prongs  on  the  handle  are  engaged  with 
corresponding  grooves  in  the  gauging  members  by  a  single  screw  providing  a  self  centring  support 
with  a  positive  lock  and  a  degree  of  rigidity  equivalent  to  that  of  a  solid  gauge. 

Size  ranges  from  1  up  to  40  mm  and  above  120  up  to  250  mm  have  been  covered  \n  IS  :  6137 
'  Gauging  members  for  plain  plug  gauges  GO  and  NO  GO  members  ( size  range  1  to  40  mm )  * 
[under  print)  and  IS:  6246  'Gauging  members  for  plain  plug  gauges  GO  and  NO  GO  members 
(  size  range  above  120  up  to  250  mm  )  •  (  under  print ),  respectively. 


Printed  at  New  India  Printing  Press.  Khurja,  India
